notes.title: Desaturation Prologue 1.0.9 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Heyo Humans, Splatians & Slimes

A color-pocalypse is happening and it's your turn to fix the mess that Lord Ashen did. 
We've heard your feedback and implemented things you proposed to make the game not that annoyingly difficult. Many things are changed between 1.0.0 and 1.0.9, but for the prologue, whatever matters the most is what we did to the Slimes. 

S.L.I.M.E. won't kill you on the slightest touch if you share a color
If you don't share color with a slime, keep distance, wait for it to jump or dash and then stomp it down. 
If even one of your colors matches the Slime color, even if that slime dashes in front of you, your life is saved. This makes S.P.A.R.K. Forest much easier map to explore.  

Check out the full game, PRICE DROP
We re also happy to announce that the price took some HP of damage and dropped as a result! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/670510/ColorBlend_FX_Desaturation

notes.title: Desaturation Prologue 1.0.0 Patch Notes + Release Date!
notes.notes:
Heyo Humans, Splatians & Slimes

A color-pocalypse is undoubtedly incoming. The secret project DESATURATION that caused the extinction of the humanity is about to enter another phase and threaten the current Earth residents, the Splatians. We are extremely thankful for your support and love for Desaturation. We are thrilled to share some news - one of which is the release date itself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40888513/32a750227497a05074c48ad8515d247a361b544e.png
Yes, that's it, the game will release in just 3 weeks, on 19 April 2024. We are very sorry for making you wait that much, but we also wanted to make the game feel as completed and polished as possible and to convert this free prologue to serve its purpose as the game demo.

Here is what's new in 1.0.0-pr5
in comparison to the old 1.0.0-whatever-it-was
Yeah, we are in this beautiful 1.0 era when lots of stuff changes but version number stays the same.

This prologue build is on par with the first release candidate of the game, but some things will change before the release.

 Total graphics overhaul such as: 
 New post processing, 
 Lots of vegetation
 More detailed geometry by using tessellation
 Levels like Library and the Forest will feel refreshed for you.
 More props, more barrels, 
 More physics details. e.g. Tables break.
 FSR 2.0 upscaler and hardware tessellation
 Some small physics tweaks and many bugfixes.
 Steam Input. Please make sure you update your controller config!

And with all these improvements, here are some possibly-sad news. I love all you achievement hunters who hunted on the old Prologue and checked every nook and cranny. When you buy the full game, your progress will carry, but the full game features much more different achievements. And achievements will not carry from the Prologue to the full game. So, I went off and removed Photons & Matter completely from the Prologue - so no Spring Shoes, coins, vents and similar. And because I prefer to be honest, another reason for this change is to make the prologue shorter with very strong call to action in its ending - and a short teaser trailer too. And your old saves will not work with the new version. Just start over, experience the updated chapter, and if you loved it.

Wishlist ColorBlend FX: Desaturation
https://store.steampowered.com/app/670510/ColorBlend_FX_Desaturation

Important for Steam Deck:
Because the game now defaults to use Steam Input, please check and reset your controller configuration to the new official one. If you want to keep constant 58-60 fps, enable manual GPU clocking and set it above 1.2GHz. The FSR 2.0 implementation in its "As Intended" quality level may actually be slower than Marketing Mode - but Balanced also works well. Alternatively, you can lower the resolution and enable FSR 1.0 for both increased frame rate and battery savings.

Help us grow!
Let us defeat Lord Ashen together! If you loved the game feel free to make videos and let's plays. If you are a blogger, feel free to review. And...

notes.title: ColorBlend FX: Desaturation Prologue 0.1.9b PATCH NOTES,
notes.notes:
Okay, I know and I've heard you all, and I'm very sorry for leaving these stupid bugs... 
After all as a almost solo dev sometimes some stuff just gets unnoticed!

Here's what is new in 0.1.9b:


 Fixed all pressure plates. This means that Photons and matter is now working
 Fixed all Slime spawners. Slimes will now properly leave pipes
 All fixes from main branch of the game and all improvements are in the prologue now
 Coins now collect automatically if they somehow leave the map
 And this time I actually did an extensive testing to ensure the quality of this build!

notes.title: Desaturation Prologue 0.1.7f Patch Notes
notes.notes:
0. Achievements should not bug out anymore.
1. All progression achievements will now unlock when you resume game if you completed them
2. Yes, I know, you hated the Spark Forest Electric pool.... so a checkpoint was added after it.
3. And I got you too, the boss is now much more challenging and have more HP! 
4. The secret speed-run mode was broken, this is now fixed and the timer also pauses during loadings!
5. Wish this in mind, SPEED RUN CONTEST is now a thing, join our Discord and stay tuned
6. Fixed the Map Screen Switch button that wasn't working
7. Fixed the Credits hard-lock.... AND added button to fast-forward the Credits!
8. In Spark Reception, changed the Cyan pool to Green one. I know, the scanner expects certain shade of pink...
9. Splatians change their colors. Malone took a yellow-red bath on his way to Eastern reception
...and more minor stuff!
